summary: Kerb runs along an apartment block 6 m away; no secluded section.

drivers.seclusion: Apartment block 6 m from the kerb from 15 m to about 50 m; more apartments 11 m beyond.
drivers.access_and_room: Cars park along the kerb, but the sections not beside the apartments are shorter than a van.
drivers.traffic: Moderately busy through road with parked cars.
drivers.convention: Cars park along it; no sign of overnight stays.

sun_shade: Apartment block shades the west side; street trees on the east.
